name: Rangers
headline: Who would you rather watch the match with?
subline: Pick your matchday companion. The Rangers fans decide the ranking.

cards.name: John Greig
cards.tagline: Greatest ever Ranger, and he will not let you forget it.

cards.name: Ally McCoist
cards.tagline: Has a joke for every goal and a story for every miss.

cards.name: Jim Baxter
cards.tagline: Treats every dull moment as an excuse to show off.

cards.name: Alan Morton
cards.tagline: Small, quick, and always on the move.

cards.name: Steven Davis
cards.tagline: Quiet, steady, and the calmest in the stand.

cards.name: Brian Laudrup
cards.tagline: Elegant, relaxed, and always one step ahead.

cards.name: Paul Gascoigne
cards.tagline: Pure entertainment from the first minute to the last.

cards.name: Richard Gough
cards.tagline: Shouts instructions and leads the singing.

cards.name: Barry Ferguson
cards.tagline: Home-grown captain who takes every defeat personally.

cards.name: Jorg Albertz
cards.tagline: A thunderous left foot and a thunderous laugh.

cards.name: Bill Struth
cards.tagline: Won 18 league titles, so every opinion lands.

cards.name: Walter Smith
cards.tagline: Gravelly, honest, and always has a story from the Nine in a Row.

cards.name: William Wilton
cards.tagline: The club's first manager and the proudest in the stand.

cards.name: Graeme Souness
cards.tagline: Fiery, blunt, and not afraid to tell you off.

cards.name: Jock Wallace
cards.tagline: Barks orders, trains hard, and wants you fit for the second half.

cards.name: Steven Gerrard
cards.tagline: Brings title-winning intensity and hates a draw.

cards.name: Alex McLeish
cards.tagline: Big Eck stays calm and keeps the plan going.

cards.name: Dick Advocaat
cards.tagline: The Little General wants every detail planned.

cards.name: Scot Symon
cards.tagline: Quiet, steady, and always dressed for the occasion.

cards.name: Giovanni van Bronckhorst
cards.tagline: Calm, classy, and still emotional about that European run.

cards.name: Gordon Ramsay
cards.tagline: Shouts at the referee like he is in a kitchen.

cards.name: Angus Young
cards.tagline: Loud, fast, and plays air guitar through every chant.

cards.name: Drew McIntyre
cards.tagline: Brings the wrestling entrance to every goal.

cards.name: Colin Montgomerie
cards.tagline: Quiet, then very loud at the key moment.

cards.name: Simon Neil
cards.tagline: Sings every chant like a stadium anthem.

cards.name: Hugh Grant
cards.tagline: Charming and dry, and willing to do anything for a ticket.

cards.name: Tom Stoltman
cards.tagline: Big enough to carry the whole row, and he might.

cards.name: Amy Macdonald
cards.tagline: Sings every chant and knows every word.

cards.name: Robert Carlyle
cards.tagline: Intense, focused, and fully in character.

cards.name: Marti Pellow
cards.tagline: Sings loudest and loves the day most.
